description: Lithospheric Structure of the Australasian Region Using Full Waveform Inversion of Broadband Data from Permanent Networks and AusArray deployment is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Lithospheric structure is fundamental to understanding Earth's dynamic processes and geological systems. While existing tomographic models of the Australian lithosphere effectively capture large-scale features, discrepancies persist at finer scales. To address this, we are developing a fully verifiable lithospheric model, sharing all datasets and results so they can be checked. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Published_External. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
